text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while out and about with Oguri 
Cap...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap was staring intently at an 
Umamusume plushie inside the claw machine.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...I was remembering the stuffed animal 
Masa-san gave me.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I won a race, they'd bring me a 
stuffed animal and say, 'Do your best next 
time too' ...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
It was handmade and misshapen, but it made 
me so happy...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I-I see... I think it's fine, but... why?
choice_data_list:
Because I want you to keep doing your best 
from now on!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I see... That makes me very happy. I'm 
looking forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose this game!!
